author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Seabold (lat) leaves game early Tuesday
desc: Connor Seabold was removed from Tuesday's game against the Rays with right lat tightness.
impact: Seabold will be further evaluated at which point an update will be provided.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connelly Early (elbow) leaves start early Tuesday
desc: Connelly Early was removed from Tuesday's start against the Nationals with left elbow discomfort.
impact: Early had been dealing over four scoreless innings prior to his injury. He will head for further evaluation before an update is provided.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Willy Adames (back) trending in right direction
desc: Giants manager Tony Vitello said Willy Adames is trending in the right direction.
impact: Adames remains day-to-day after sitting out his second straight game on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Diaz (elbow) could face live hitters this weekend
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Edwin Díaz could progress to facing hitters in a live batting practice session this weekend.
impact: Diaz remains on track to return at some point after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Winkler signs minor league deal with Athletics
desc: The Athletics signed 2B Jack Winkler to a minor league contract.
impact: Winkler will add infield depth in the Athletics organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Slater re-signs with Rays on minor league deal
desc: The Rays re-signed OF Austin Slater to a minor league contract.
impact: Slater makes his return after testing free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brent Rooker (knee) getting re-evaluated Tuesday
desc: Brent Rooker is away from the Athletics on Tuesday being re-evaluated at Stanford for his knee injury.
impact: "I wouldn't say that his progress has stopped," Mark Kotsay said. "... it hasn't progressed as efficient as we'd like. So he's down there going through another exam."

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kris Bubic (elbow) set for another rehab start Wednesday
desc: Kris Bubic is scheduled to make his next rehab start on Wednesday.
impact: Bubic threw 22 pitches over two innings on Saturday. He is scheduled to pitch three innings on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Estevez (shoulder) being re-evaluated Tuesday
desc: Carlos Estevez is being re-evaluated on Tuesday.
impact: Estevez suffered a setback during a bullpen session over the weekend. There should be an update on his status later in the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: AJ Smith-Shawver (elbow) throws 41 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: AJ Smith-Shawver threw 41 pitches over three innings during a rehab start with Single-A Augusta on Tuesday.
impact: Smith-Shawver allowed one run on three hits while striking out four. He is continuing to work his way back from Tommy John surgery.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam Huff sent outright by Orioles
desc: The Orioles sent C Sam Huff outright to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Huff will remain in the Orioles organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ben Hartl traded to White Sox
desc: The White Sox acquired C Ben Hartl from the Rangers for RHP Ben Peoples.
impact: Hartl was selected in the 14th round of the 2024 MLB Draft. He'll add catching depth in the lower levels of the White Sox organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ben Peoples traded to Rangers
desc: The Rangers acquired RHP Ben Peoples from the White Sox for C Ben Hartl.
impact: Peoples will add relief depth in Triple-A for Texas.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong will not participate in home run derby
desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong will not compete in next month's All-Star Home Run Derby.
impact: Crow-Armstrong has been one of the best hitters in baseball in the month of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vince Velasquez elects free agency
impact: Velasquez went unclaimed on waivers after he was designated for assignment. He will be free to sign with any team.
